mobInteract first handles Fedora, then chargeable tag while notSensing: snapshot superCharged from second tag, shrink1 unless player.isCreative, setSensing true and sidedSuccess. There is no explicit own server-side, adult, habitat, pending-loot or owner gate. In the shown branch charge quality is sampled before debit; no waiter/player UUID/receipt/refund is stored. Later native interaction composition and actual inventory debit were not run.

Dropped-item route is actual registered CreatureAITargetItems(false,false,40,15), requiring empty mainhand and age>40 at target selection in a radius15 cube, with current item foodstuff membership. The anonymous canUse calls super FIRST then tests !Sensing, so rejected selection may retain helper-selected target/onFind callback without starting. Continuation also tests !Sensing. Within distanceSquared<2 native helper invokes onGetItem before shrink1 and direct stop. Callback sets charge tier/Sensing only if current stack belongs to chargeables. No source claim that foodstuff/chargeable tags overlap, no Owner/pickup-delay gate at this custom sink and no recheck of food/age at debit. Shared helper itself0.

Sensing participates in shouldEnterWater unlessHasEgg; ordinary leave-water desire is suppressed while sensing but HasEgg still forces leave. FindWater1 and LeaveWater1 use MOVE/LOOK and sampled navigation requests. Dig goal priority5 declares no flags: native Goal defaults empty, so scheduler flag locking does not exclude concurrent move/panic/mate goals solely by priority; it may share navigation. Swim controller stops speed while digging, but source travel/previous velocity/navigation ordering do not establish arrival or immobility. No helper/path/collision guarantee.

Dig canUse only checks Sensing and generatePosCooldown. At0 resets20..39, searches, draws maxDroppedItems2..6, returns candidate!=null; whilepositive decrements only on eligible canUse calls. Failed search leaves Sensing and no explicit global deadline. In water, genSeafloor samples15 XZ[-7,7] currentY and descends through WATER whileY>1, accepting first digable substrate; land samples15 outerXZ[-7,7],Y+3, descendsAIR and ifWATER runs inner15 search. This is bounded per evaluation, not225 distinct references, globally bounded time or a standable reachable path. Initial canUse does not itself require water above returned substrate; continuation checks it only later.

Continuation requires targetnull, Sensing, lastHurtByMobnull, nonnull candidate, current digables tag and water above. No age/path/isInWater/current distance or elapsed deadline. Natural selector cleanup invokes wrapped stop when failed; invalid target/hurt/state ends charge with no refund. Native serverAiStep alternates full selectors and requiresUpdateEveryTick-running calls; dig inheritsfalse, so digTime counts delivered goal ticks and not unconditional world ticks/seconds.

Near distanceSquared<2 to center(substrate.above), addY-.01, stop navigation and increment digTime. Every5 delivered near updates emits event/sound request; every floor(100/maxDroppedItems) invokes reward dispatch, then at>=100 clearsSensing/Digging and resetsdigTime. Away only clearsDigging and moves; it does NOT resetdigTime, so near updates can accumulate across separations. For n2..6 under uninterrupted normal calls100 updates schedule n table rolls (interval50,33,25,20,16), not n actual item units/entities. Higher-tier selection uses current superCharged field each roll; no per-roll payment or player owner.

Reward IDs gameplay/platypus_reward or gameplay/platypus_supercharged_reward are looked up from current server loot resolver; LootParams supplies THIS_ENTITY with PIGLIN_BARTER (required onlyTHIS_ENTITY, default luck0). Manager uses current resource reload map; resolver missing table returns LootTable.EMPTY. LootTable applies pools/functions/feature-enabled splitting then Forge global modifier chain. Thus raw loot JSON absence blocks exact items, quantities/probabilities/conditions or guaranteed nonempty result; even fallback EMPTY can be modified by global hooks. No specific redstone/glowstone/diamond or default deployed table assertion.

For each returned stack, mod passes stack.copy (native preserves NBT/caps), calls spawnAtLocation then dereferences result without null guard to set impulse/reduce velocity. Native returnsnull for empty/client; otherwise constructs ItemEntity/default pickup delay, either appends to captureDrops collection or calls addFreshEntity without checking bool, then returns entity regardless admission. Global modifiers can in principle introduce empty stack; null dereference is conditional source hazard, not reproduced crash. Nonnull spawn return/event/sound/counter completion is not world-admission or material pickup receipt.
